subject: Regarding standard deviation and SEM in hbond analysis

messages.author: Rajarshi Roy
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users and development team,
I have a quick question regarding the hbond command of cpptraj module. In
the output file of hbond analysis, we have the average distance and average
angle of each and every hbond. Is there any way to print the STD and SEM
regarding the same parameters?
I really appreciate any help if you can provide.
-- 
*with regards*
*Rajarshi Roy*
*PhD Research Scholar*
*Biosciences and Biomedical Engineering*
*Indian Institute of Technology, Indore*
*India*

messages.author: Daniel Roe
messages.body:
Hi,
Adding standard deviation to hbond distance/angle is on my to-do list
(
https://github.com/Amber-MD/cpptraj/issues/392
). I will try my best
to get to it soon, but I can't make any promises on exact timelines...
-Dan
